_comment: Reference copy. The live file is %LOCALAPPDATA%\ClaudeGovee\config.json, written with defaults on first run and hot-reloaded on save. Property names are case-insensitive.
_comment_gradient: Settled by observation: use 0. The DOCX says 1 = gradient on, but the DLL's internal field is named _gradientOffSkus and the field name was right. At 1 the segment colours are flattened, so chase/comet/wipe/progress/sparkle/rainbow all render as a uniform pulse while every call still reports success. Only flip to 1 if your SKU behaves the other way - see docs/API-NOTES.md.
_comment_devices: Leave empty to drive every LAN-enabled device automatically. Segments is discovered from GetDeviceBaseInfo when 0 - do not trust device_info.ini, which reports a flat 10 for everything. Each device may also carry its own "States" map, layered over the global one: {"Name":"Desk","States":{"Thinking":{"Effect":"solid"}}} makes only that device sit still while Thinking.
_comment_rest: The Govee API cannot read a device's current colour, so OnSessionEnd 'rest' means 'apply RestColor', not 'put back what was there'. Use 'off' if you care about a scene surviving.
_comment_states: Effects: solid, breathe, pulse, blink, chase, comet, wipe, progress, sparkle, rainbow. Chase, comet, wipe, progress and rainbow need SegmentNums > 1 and fall back to breathe otherwise. Every field is optional and inherits when omitted, so an entry may set Hz alone. Modifiers: Color2, Direction (forward|reverse|pingpong), Easing (linear|sine|cubic|expo), Tail, Depth, FullSeconds. Brightness -1 leaves it alone. See docs/EFFECTS.md.
_comment_examples: Not read by the daemon. The names below are recipe labels, NOT state names - a States key must be one of Idle, Thinking, ToolRead, ToolEdit, ToolShell, ToolWeb, ToolMcp, ToolAgent, ToolOther, Compacting, WaitingUser, Error, Done, Offline, and anything else is ignored (and logged as config_unknown_state). Copy the VALUE onto a real state name, e.g. "ToolShell": { "Effect": "chase", "Direction": "pingpong", "Hz": 0.8 }.
_comment_tools: Overrides only - the built-in map already covers the standard tools. Anything starting with mcp__ is classified as ToolMcp automatically.
